decision: Adopt115v6 after all required local tests and actual public API/CLI/whole-issue checks. Remote CI is a separate publication gate.
scope: Native ruled-cell order and complete coordinate rows. NDLOCR stays0.0.15, commitf97e930b8c3e9512f7788f258ef685da26416483. No new dependency, semantic model, automatic OCR fusion, Word geometry edits or Table creation.
general_evidence: Require complete positive finite native glyph bounds for all Used Words, explicit rightward axes, unique occurrence ownership, a complete nonoverlapping leaf-cell partition and source rulings continuously separating occupied cells. Existing Tables are barriers.

Finish each physical source cell in row/column order, preserving its internal occurrence order and closed balanced delimiter spans. Never borrow membership across units, comparison roles or parts. Reconstructing any changed/stale line must fail closed rather than erase earlier repairs.

Repeated distinct overlapping native glyph bands across cells certify record ambiguity, so retain the prior whole-frame row sequence. Adjacent fields join only with a common native glyph band and the same physical source frame and row. Preserve complete old lines when their occurrence sequence survives.

Non-grid text is opaque and retains its original internal order. Relocation requires disjoint native support and both a source-ruling-certified predecessor and successor in a unique bounded gap. Shared projections and actual continuous rulings are required; diagonal, contradictory or unbounded evidence does not authorize a move.

Optional coordinate header prefixes use arbitrary complete owned alphabetic labels, not a known heading vocabulary. At least two subsequent complete consecutive records must satisfy the existing paired numeric coordinate and six-original-glyph proofs. Header text remains unchanged.

Before committing a flow rewrite, require the exact unique occurrence multiset and identical nonwhitespace characters. The separate existing coordinate restoration may only map the original angle glyphs after complete row ownership is proved.
no_result_specific_production_branches: No page/PDF ID, company/issuer/title, expected-output lookup or source-specific geometry constant.

No new character, line, column or maximum record-count caps. Two distinct bands/records are the minimum evidence of repetition/consecutive records. Existing numeric-coordinate grammar and legacy heuristics still exist and are not claimed eliminated.

Native bounds and exact Word identity are structural witnesses; arbitrary text replacements, scale/translation, incomplete geometry, conflicting axes/owners, Tables, unbalanced grammar and stale repaired lines have regression coverage.
